summary: Valley County, ID log cabin, 1930s, on Boise/Payette NF; listed abandoned, FFLA list says gone; no source describes what remains or public access.

facts.status_note: Two pages say abandoned; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list says gone; no source says when or how it disappeared or what remains

evidence.supports: 1930s log cabin, date attributed to Kresek

evidence.quote: We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

evidence.supports: Forest Fire Lookout Association Idaho list marks it gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks the lookout gone; the two detailed pages say only abandoned. Both are kept: 'gone' in the record, and the story says the pages call it abandoned and that none says when it disappeared.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: no dated events, only the 1930s cabin and the word abandoned on two pages. The FFLA list says gone, which is the basis for the brief's status; the detail pages do not say it was removed, so the story says so. Forest Lookouts quotes a 1930s date attributed to 'Kresek', which the story leaves unidentified. Forest Lookouts also includes a 1959 Coast and Geodetic Survey station description (Yellow Pine horse pack route) for a marker on the same peak; it is not used because it describes a survey station, not the lookout site. No source describes the site now or public access, so access is omitted. Staffing is unknown; Idaho Fire Lookouts reports no documented history. Reads: three lookout pages plus the FFLA list, and two WebSearches.
